summary: First Mining Gold Corp., a Vancouver-based gold developer listed in the U.S. as a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO interim certifications. No transaction, solicitation, or corporate action is announced. Disclosures include cash of C$78.1 million, mineral properties of C$305.3 million, and a C$135.1 million silver stream derivative liability. This is a routine quarterly reporting filing, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
